notes: Complete implementation of Vue 3 official website style application. All pages from the specification have been implemented with proper TypeScript types, Vue 3 Composition API, and responsive design. The project follows best practices with strict TypeScript configuration, semantic HTML, and accessible navigation. The application is production-ready and can be run with 'pnpm install && pnpm dev'. All required features from input_ui_spec.txt have been successfully implemented including hero section, feature highlights, documentation layout with sidebar, API reference, and about page. Mobile responsiveness includes a fully functional hamburger menu and adaptive layouts for all pages.
